title: Is the U.S. Banking System Ready for a Post-Quantum Future?
summary_en: Sultan Meghji argues that the hardest cryptographic deadline facing U.S. banks is being set by SWIFT and foreign supervisors, not Washington. Adversaries are harvesting encrypted financial traffic now. Three of the four fixes require no new statutory authority.
title_cn: Is the U.S. Banking System Ready for a Post-Quantum Future?

title: The AI Industry Is Coalescing on “Pacing the Frontier.” Will It Actually Change Anything?
summary_en: Over the past week, frontier labs, policymakers, and the U.S. public have reached remarkable consensus around calls to pace AI development. What now? Aalok Mehta outlines the four steps government and industry must take to translate the current moment into durable change.
title_cn: The AI Industry Is Coalescing on “Pacing the Frontier.” Will It Actually Change Anything?

title: Building and Using a U.S. Polar Defense Industrial Base
summary_en: As great power competition intensifies, expanding the U.S. polar industrial base can bolster U.S. defense capabilities, support the peaceful governance of the Arctic and Antarctic, and create new economic opportunities at home.
title_cn: Building and Using a U.S. Polar Defense Industrial Base

title: Six Charts to Explain the Global Energy Crisis
summary_en: The conflict with Iran continues to redraw the energy map. Six charts show how major producers and consumers are stabilizing markets through reserve releases, lower imports, and increased U.S. production of oil, gas, and helium.
title_cn: Six Charts to Explain the Global Energy Crisis

title: Don’t Slow Down AI Development—Speed Up Benchmarking
summary_en: Ben Jensen and Yasir Atalan argue that the United States should stop debating how fast to build and start funding independent benchmarking—through NSF, NIST, and university policy labs.
title_cn: Don’t Slow Down AI Development—Speed Up Benchmarking

title: Beyond the Memory Cycle: AI, HBM, and the New Semiconductor Shortage
summary_en: AI-driven demand for high-bandwidth memory is reshaping the semiconductor memory market, creating shortages across industries and raising new questions about U.S. supply chain resilience, investment, and the risk of future overcapacity.
title_cn: Beyond the Memory Cycle: AI, HBM, and the New Semiconductor Shortage

title: CSIS Press Briefing: Previewing the Trump-Xi Summit
summary_en: The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) hosted a call-in press briefing to preview the upcoming Trump-Xi Summit.
title_cn: CSIS Press Briefing: Previewing the Trump-Xi Summit

title: AI Security Threats Aren’t a Hoax—But They Also Aren’t as Existential as They Might Seem
summary_en: From a national security perspective, the abuses of AI outlined in Anthropic’s report aren’t especially new or surprising—in fact, they are consistent with how threat actors already behave, using AI to enhance the speed, scale, efficacy, and reach of their operations.
title_cn: AI Security Threats Aren’t a Hoax—But They Also Aren’t as Existential as They Might Seem
